svg.desc: End-to-end multi-agent orchestration: fraud routing, cross-agent security guardrails, blocking and unblocking lifecycle. Read interactions from top to bottom. Dashed arrows are replies.
svg.text: 09 / FinCrime multi-agent orchestration and card lifecycle
End-to-end multi-agent orchestration: fraud routing, cross-agent security guardrails, blocking and unblocking lifecycle.
Time flows downward | Solid arrow: call | Dashed arrow: reply | Yellow: explanation
Microservice Architecture: fincrime-agent and fincrime-api run as dedicated containerized services with separate databases and MCP policies.
